caption: Figure 4: Change in sample quality as we vary scale of the classifier gradients for a class-conditional ImageNet 128 × 128 model.
description:
Section 1: Figure 4 displays three plots showing the impact of varying the gradient scale on the quality of generated images for a class-conditional ImageNet 128 × 128 model. The first plot compares FID and sFID, with sFID starting higher and increasing more steeply. The second plot shows IS values, which rise steadily. The third plot compares precision and recall, with precision starting higher and remaining above recall throughout.

Section 2: Text in figure: gradient scale, FID, sFID, IS, precision, recall. Values: FID starts at 4, peaks at 16; sFID starts at 5, peaks at 15; IS starts at 100, peaks at 300; precision starts at 0.7, peaks at 0.9; recall starts at 0.6, peaks at 0.7.

## Figure description
The figure contains two plots. The left plot is a precision-recall curve comparing "BigGAN-deep" and "Classifier guidance (ours)". The "Classifier guidance (ours)" curve is higher across all precision values. The right plot is a FID-IS curve for the same two methods. The "BigGAN-deep" curve is higher across all IS values.

## Figure content
Left plot: Precision, Recall, BigGAN-deep, Classifier guidance (ours), 0.70, 0.75, 0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95
